name: Data Count
description: Admin report that counts published/unpublished nodes per content type and active/inactive users per role.
project_description: Data Count is a lightweight statistical report for site administrators. It adds a single page under Reports (/admin/reports/data-count) that counts every node and user on the site. The node view breaks down published and unpublished counts for each content type, with grand totals; the user view breaks down active and inactive user counts for each custom role. Every figure links straight to the matching filtered admin/content or admin/people listing, so the report doubles as a jumping-off point for content and account audits. It requires no configuration, no Views, and no non-core dependencies — only the node and user modules — and reads counts directly from the database at page load.
